推荐英文（B1）: Hi, I have a room booked for two nights.
推荐英文（B2）: Hi, I've got a booking for two nights.
推荐英文（C1）: Hi, I have a reservation for two nights.
说明: 避免直译“I booked two nights”缺宾语；C1 用 reservation 语域更正式。

推荐英文（B1）: Can I see your passport, please?
推荐英文（B2）: Passport, please.
推荐英文（C1）: I'll need to see your passport, please.
说明: 前台冷淡人设可用 B2 的省略句，体现角色语气。

中文原句: 没有护照，我不能确认你的身份。
推荐英文（B1）: Without your passport, I can't check who you are.
推荐英文（B2）: Without your passport, I cannot verify your identity.
推荐英文（C1）: Without a passport, there's no way for me to authenticate your identity.
说明: B2 版命中 KP-B2-0412 verify your identity；B1 用 check who you are 降级；C1 可替换为 authenticate（KP-C1-0145）。片中填空题即取 B2 句。

中文原句: 按照意大利法律，我必须登记你的护照。
推荐英文（B1）: In Italy, the law says I must record your passport.
推荐英文（B2）: Under Italian law, I have to register your passport.
推荐英文（C1）: Under Italian law, I'm obliged to register every guest's passport.
说明: B2 句型对应 KP-B2-0957 under the law（词形 under Italian law）。

推荐英文（B1）: Sorry, we're full tonight.
推荐英文（B2）: I'm afraid we're fully booked tonight.
推荐英文（C1）: I'm afraid we don't have a single room left tonight.
说明: 不要写 the room is full（指房间里人满）。

中文原句: 退房时间是上午十一点。
推荐英文（B1）: You need to check out by eleven.
推荐英文（B2）: Check-out is at eleven a.m.
推荐英文（C1）: We'd ask you to check out no later than eleven.
说明: check out 为 B1 短语，B2 剧本中出现但不标黄。

中文原句: 能不能通融一下，就这一次？
推荐英文（B1）: Can you help me, just this one time?
推荐英文（B2）: Couldn't you make an exception, just this once?
推荐英文（C1）: Couldn't you bend the rules, just this once?
说明: B2 命中 make an exception；C1 命中 bend the rules。避免 please be flexible 的翻译腔。

中文原句: 押金五十欧，退房时退还。
推荐英文（B1）: It's a fifty-euro deposit. You get it back when you leave.
推荐英文（B2）: There's a fifty-euro deposit, refunded at check-out.
推荐英文（C1）: We take a fifty-euro deposit, which is refunded when you check out.
说明: 数字与货币统一用 euro 小写。

中文原句: 我要报案，我的钱包被偷了。
推荐英文（B1）: I want to tell the police. Someone stole my wallet.
推荐英文（B2）: I need to report a theft. My wallet was stolen.
推荐英文（C1）: I'd like to report a theft. My wallet's been taken.
说明: B2 命中 KP-B2-0388 report a theft；B1 拆成两句降低难度。

推荐英文（B1）: Where did it happen?
推荐英文（B2）: Where exactly was it stolen?
推荐英文（C1）: Can you tell me exactly where it was taken?
说明: 警察角色语气中性、程序化。

推荐英文（B1）: I just came back from the police station.
推荐英文（B2）: I've just come from the police station.
推荐英文（C1）: I've come straight from the police station.
说明: 英式现在完成时更自然；避免 I just now returned。

推荐英文（B1）: This is the paper from the police.
推荐英文（B2）: Here's the police report.
推荐英文（C1）: Here's a copy of the police report.
说明: receipt 不适用于报案回执。

推荐英文（B1）: It must be a thief.
推荐英文（B2）: It must have been a pickpocket.
推荐英文（C1）: It was almost certainly a pickpocket.
说明: B2 命中 pickpocket；注意 must have been 的推测语法。

推荐英文（B1）: Sorry, I was wrong about you.
推荐英文（B2）: Sorry, I got the wrong idea about you.
推荐英文（C1）: I'm sorry. I completely misjudged you.
说明: 避免 I misunderstand you（时态错误且语义偏）。

推荐英文（B1）: I need to say sorry to you.
推荐英文（B2）: I think I owe you an apology.
推荐英文（C1）: I owe you an apology, and a proper one.
说明: B2 命中 owe someone an apology。

推荐英文（B1）: Sorry for the trouble.
推荐英文（B2）: Sorry to cause you so much trouble.
推荐英文（C1）: I'm sorry for putting you through all this.
说明: 不可直译 add trouble to you。

中文原句: 我们是不是在哪儿见过？
推荐英文（B1）: Have we met before?
推荐英文（B2）: Have we met somewhere before?
推荐英文（C1）: I could swear we've met before.
说明: 经典搭讪句，三级差异主要在语气。

中文原句: 你戴面具的时候，我就认出你了。
推荐英文（B1）: I knew it was you, even with the mask.
推荐英文（B2）: I recognized you, even behind the mask.
推荐英文（C1）: Even behind that mask, I'd have known you anywhere.
说明: recognize 为 B1，B2 剧本中不标黄。

中文原句: 那晚你为什么不告而别？
推荐英文（B1）: Why did you leave that night without saying goodbye?
推荐英文（B2）: Why did you disappear that night without a word?
推荐英文（C1）: Why did you vanish that night without so much as a goodbye?
说明: C1 so much as 属高阶结构，控制密度。

推荐英文（B1）: I think I like you.
推荐英文（B2）: I think I'm falling for you.
推荐英文（C1）: I think I've fallen for you, and it scares me.
说明: B2 命中 fall for；避免 I seem to like you。

推荐英文（B1）: Wow, I see you here again!
推荐英文（B2）: What a coincidence, running into you here again.
推荐英文（C1）: Of all the places to run into you again.
说明: B2 命中 coincidence。C1 为地道习语化表达。

推荐英文（B1）: Why should I believe you?
推荐英文（B2）: Why should I take your word for it?
推荐英文（C1）: Give me one reason to take you at your word.
说明: B2 命中 take someone's word for it。

推荐英文（B1）: No. We can't talk about this.
推荐英文（B2）: That's out of the question.
推荐英文（C1）: That's simply not up for discussion.
说明: B2 命中 out of the question；B1 保留拒绝语气即可。

中文原句: 这是规定，不是我个人的意思。
推荐英文（B1）: It's the rule. It's not my idea.
推荐英文（B2）: It's hotel policy, not my personal choice.
推荐英文（C1）: It's policy. Believe me, it's nothing personal.
说明: B2 命中 policy；不要写 my personal meaning。

推荐英文（B1）: Calm down and listen to me.
推荐英文（B2）: Calm down and hear me out.
推荐英文（C1）: Just take a breath and hear me out.
说明: calm down 为 B1 短语。

中文原句: 你宁愿让一个女人淋着雨流落街头？
推荐英文（B1）: You want a woman to stay outside in the rain?
推荐英文（B2）: So you'd rather leave a woman alone in the rain?
推荐英文（C1）: So you'd honestly rather leave a woman stranded in the rain?
说明: would rather 结构在 B2 剧本中常用于对质。

中文原句: 我可不想因为你丢了执照。
推荐英文（B1）: I don't want to lose my license because of you.
推荐英文（B2）: I'd rather not lose my license over this.
推荐英文（C1）: I'm not going to jeopardize my license for one guest.
说明: C1 命中 jeopardize；license 统一美式拼写。

中文原句: 你这理由不太有说服力。
推荐英文（B1）: That's not a good reason.
推荐英文（B2）: That's not a very convincing reason.
推荐英文（C1）: That's hardly a compelling reason.
说明: C1 命中 compelling。

推荐英文（B1）: It was you that night!
推荐英文（B2）: So you were the one that night!
推荐英文（C1）: So it was you all along!
说明: 反转句要短促，三级差异不宜过大。

推荐英文（B1）: Were you lying to me the whole time?
推荐英文（B2）: Have you been lying to me all this time?
推荐英文（C1）: So this whole time, you've been playing me?
说明: C1 playing me 为口语习语，需审核是否符合角色。

推荐英文（B1）: The man under the mask... was you?
推荐英文（B2）: The man behind the mask... it was you?
推荐英文（C1）: The man behind the mask... it was you all along?
说明: 避免 under the mask 在 B2 及以上出现。

推荐英文（B1）: I know who you are now.
推荐英文（B2）: I think I know who you are.
推荐英文（C1）: I know exactly who you are.
说明: 2-1 结尾句采用 B2 版，留悬念。

推荐英文（B1）: I have nowhere to go tonight.
推荐英文（B2）: I've got nowhere else to go tonight.
推荐英文（C1）: I've literally got nowhere else to go tonight.
说明: literally 在 C1 口语中可用，但不宜高频。

推荐英文（B1）: My phone has no battery.
推荐英文（B2）: My phone's run out of battery.
推荐英文（C1）: My phone died on me.
说明: run out of 为 B1 短语；不可写 my phone has no electricity。

中文原句: 明天你得去大使馆办临时护照。
推荐英文（B1）: Tomorrow you need to go to the embassy for a new passport.
推荐英文（B2）: You'll need a temporary passport from your embassy tomorrow.
推荐英文（C1）: First thing tomorrow, you should get an emergency passport from your embassy.
说明: B2 命中 embassy、temporary；注意同一句不堆叠两个以上标黄项。

中文原句: 这里在狂欢节期间特别挤。
推荐英文（B1）: It's very crowded here during Carnival.
推荐英文（B2）: It gets really crowded here during Carnival.
推荐英文（C1）: The place is absolutely packed during Carnival.
说明: Carnival 作专名首字母大写，不作为知识点。

中文原句: 顺便问一下，你叫什么名字？
推荐英文（B1）: By the way, what's your name?
推荐英文（B2）: By the way, I never got your name.
推荐英文（C1）: I don't think I ever caught your name.
说明: B2/C1 版更符合久别重逢的语境。
